subject: Mobile Development
title: Crash Reporting and Analytics
description: A short lesson to help you apply Crash Reporting and Analytics.

hook.text: An app crashes. The user sees a brief flash. The developer sees a stack trace.

buildup.text: Crash reporting tools like Firebase Crashlytics capture the exact error and send it back.

discovery.text: Developers can see which device, OS version, and screen caused the crash.

twist.text: The top 1% of crashes usually affect 90% of users. Fixing those few bugs matters most.

climax.text: Crash reporting turns invisible failures into actionable data that improves the app.

punchline.text: Every crash is a bug report from the field.

quiz.question: What does Firebase Crashlytics do?
options: Captures crash data and sends it to developers
